error_categories.name: Scanned / image-only PDFs (no extractable text)
examples: CU Regulation Student Code of Conduct (1).pdf
error_categories.impact: Document cannot be analyzed at all; returns 'OCR required'.
error_categories.recommendation: Integrate an OCR fallback (e.g. Tesseract via pytesseract or PyMuPDF OCR) for image-only PDFs. Currently flagged, not processed.

error_categories.name: Coordinate mapping failures
error_categories.impact: Phrase identified but cannot be highlighted in the PDF.
error_categories.recommendation: Improve multi-line / reflowed phrase search; add a word-coordinate fallback that assembles bboxes from the extractor's word list when search_for() misses.

error_categories.name: Important-phrase recall gap
error_categories.impact: System misses descriptive multi-word gold phrases.
error_categories.root_cause: YAKE + domain lexicon favor short keyword phrases; long descriptive spans (e.g. 'criminal proceeding', 'financial extortion') are never generated as candidates.
error_categories.recommendation: Expand education/risk lexicons (esp. legal/anti-ragging terms); add spaCy noun-chunk candidates; allow 4-5 word n-grams in YAKE for policy language.

error_categories.name: Table-of-contents / front-matter captured as clauses
error_categories.impact: Noisy short 'clauses' (e.g. '1.0 Title & Commencement 04') with trailing page numbers inflate clause counts.
error_categories.recommendation: Detect and skip TOC pages (lines ending in a page number, dot-leaders); or drop clauses shorter than N chars with a trailing number pattern.

error_categories.name: Summaries echo the clause (limited compression)
error_categories.impact: One-line summaries are faithful but not always shorter than the source for single-sentence clauses.
error_categories.root_cause: Base t5-small is not fine-tuned; extractive fallback returns the key sentence which for atomic clauses equals the clause.
error_categories.recommendation: Swap t5-small for a summarization-tuned checkpoint (e.g. flan-t5-base or a fine-tuned model) if abstractive compression is required.
